project.name: Valtherion Online: First Playable Slice
project.description: A small first-person fantasy encounter used to prove the idea-to-game asset pipeline end to end.

constraints: Keep generated source files and review renders with each asset.
Confirm engine import settings before runtime integration.

styleGuide.prompt: Moody, painterly dark fantasy; weathered stone, cold blue moonlight, restrained amber magic. Keep character proportions and materials consistent across assets.
styleGuide.notes: Replace the placeholder reference path with an approved concept image before running generation stages.

assets.name: Moonlit wayfarer
assets.prompt: Create a game-ready full-body fantasy wayfarer matching the style guide. Preserve the silhouette and clothing from the approved reference; provide clean topology suitable for rigging.

assets.name: Ruined courtyard
assets.prompt: A compact ruined courtyard at night, readable as a playable space with a clear entrance, central landmark, and room for one enemy encounter.

assets.name: Warding burst
assets.prompt: A short amber rune pulse around the wayfarer's hand, readable against a dark background and designed for a game-time effect.

qualityChecks: Compare front and three-quarter renders against the reference.
Check texture coverage and visible seams.
Check normals, scale, transforms, and exportable geometry.
Validate the skeleton and bind pose.
Check deformation at shoulders, hips, and knees.
Review idle and walk cycles in a contact sheet.
Check that clips loop and have named actions.
Re-import exports and compare against the Blender source.
Check playable scale and clear navigation.
Review composition and character readability in rendered PNGs.
Open the exported scene in the target runtime.
Render frames at start, peak, and end of effect.
Inspect rendered PNG frames for clipping, readability, and alpha handling.
Import character, courtyard, and effect into Valtherion-Online.
Confirm scale, materials, animation playback, and one playable encounter.

scenes.name: Moonlit courtyard encounter
scenes.prompt: A short playable encounter that introduces movement, one warding ability, and a single enemy in the ruined courtyard.

deliverables.name: First playable encounter
acceptanceCriteria: A player can enter the courtyard, move, and trigger the warding effect.
Character, environment, and VFX pass visual review using rendered PNGs.
Source Blender files and runtime exports are traceable to their manifest stages.
